Hygge — Full App Review (multi-agent audit)
Execution tracker
Part 1 — Correctness (16 bugs)  — 11/16 done (Batch 1: builds clean + launch verified)
Part 2 — UX quick-wins  — 5.5/6 done
Part 3 — Long-term foundations  — 2.5/4 done
CORRECTNESS — full detail
[1] A REST-layer 401 (server-revoked/rejected token) never invalidates AuthStore's session or forces re-login

[2] Stale join()/receiveLoop() Task from a cancelled connection attempt is never cancellation-checked, so a background→foreground cycle can spin up a duplicate receive loop on the new socket and double-count reconnect backoff
[3] Reminders.parseTime silently mis-schedules "Midnight"-labeled events (falls back to noon)
[4] confidentPhoto cache key omits coordinate — shared venue-name strings leak a wrong-venue confidence result
[5] CalendarExport.addDay swallows per-event save failures and still reports success once one event lands
[6] GooglePlacesService caches have no in-flight de-duplication, undermining the file's own cost-discipline goal
[7] MapSheet stays collapsed at peek height when a spot is preselected at mount
[8] Live-glow / 'Now' badges go stale because nothing drives a re-render off wall-clock time
[9] Optimistic RSVP can be silently reverted by a concurrent load()
[10] RollCallSection and QuestSection show a false empty/zero state on every Home-tab revisit, unlike the Today section which has a loading guard
[11] Explore feed silently rebrands network failures as "nothing here yet"
[12] Club join/leave has no in-flight guard — out-of-order requests can leave local state opposite the server
[13] Explore feed uses a plain VStack (not lazy) so every card — and every trail's geocode network call — renders/fires eagerly on load
[14] Onboarding/profile hydration is device-session-scoped, not per-user — a second account on the same device permanently skips onboarding and inherits the previous user's local identity mirror
[15] Weekly-repeat event posting has no rollback or idempotency — a mid-loop failure leaves partial events live and a retry duplicates them
[16] VenuePhoto shows a stale (wrong-venue) photo when its inputs change under a reused view identity
UX & INNOVATION — full detail
FLOW: First-run: Splash -> Login -> Onboarding wizard -> Map-intro finale
[friction|impact=high|effort=S] "Explore the map" doesn't open the map
[friction|impact=high|effort=S] No "forgot password" path anywhere
[friction|impact=high|effort=M] The map never asks for or uses real location — "Recenter" recenters to nothing
[friction|impact=high|effort=M] Sign-up funnels through an email-confirmation round trip with zero preview of the town first
[longterm|impact=high|effort=L] Foundational bet: prove the town is real before asking for an account
[friction|impact=medium|effort=S] "Skip for now" on Welcome skips the map finale too
[improvement|impact=medium|effort=S] The login screen is a blank form right after a bold coral splash
[innovation|impact=medium|effort=M] Interest picking is pure form-fill with no live payoff until the very end
FLOW: Daily Home / Today tab
[friction|impact=high|effort=S] Dead search icon in the masthead — a tappable-looking button that does nothing
[friction|impact=high|effort=M] Two un-reconciled 'today' feeds compete for the same three seconds
[innovation|impact=high|effort=L] Unify weather + almanac + curated highlight into one true 'Now' card
[longterm|impact=high|effort=L] The real foundational bet: put 'Today' on the Home Screen as a widget
[friction|impact=medium|effort=M] Almanac, Roll Call, and Quest are three identically-dressed cards that blur together
[friction|impact=medium|effort=M] A quiet week stacks five separate 'nothing happening' messages
[improvement|impact=medium|effort=M] AroundTownCarousel is a static, date-blind detour inside a live daily feed
[innovation|impact=medium|effort=M] Replace three parallel daily 'asks' with one rotating invite slot
FLOW: Live town map (Life360-style)
[friction|impact=high|effort=M] "Recenter" has no user location to recenter to — the map never shows the user's own position
[improvement|impact=high|effort=M] Pins are binary (live or nothing) — the map looks dead all day until an event's exact start minute
[longterm|impact=high|effort=L] There is no ambient social presence signal at all — the map's only "life" is curated event data
[friction|impact=medium|effort=S] Filter chip opens a native system Menu, breaking the map's own visual language
[friction|impact=medium|effort=S] Offline/error state is handled twice, inconsistently, and the primary UI is a dead end
[improvement|impact=medium|effort=S] The map's empty state is a dead blank moment — but the app already has real, on-brand filler content sitting unused
[innovation|impact=medium|effort=L] No glanceable surface for "it's live right now" outside the app — the map only works if you happen to open it
[friction|impact=low|effort=S] "Live now" is signaled two different ways for the identical event, in the same feature
[innovation|impact=low|effort=S] The town pill is Hygge's most dynamic piece of chrome but does nothing when tapped
FLOW: Community calendar (BeReal-style) + Apple Calendar export
[friction|impact=high|effort=S] The Calendar tab has zero "add" affordance — even though its own empty state invites it
[friction|impact=high|effort=S] Tapping an empty day is a dead end instead of an invitation to fill it
[friction|impact=high|effort=M] RSVP exists in the data model and on Home, but is missing from the Calendar tab entirely
[innovation|impact=high|effort=M] Posting an event is a full form up front; borrow Partiful/Luma's progressive-disclosure quick-add
[longterm|impact=high|effort=L] Long-term bet: make Apple Calendar sync passive (a subscribed feed), not a manual per-day copy
[friction|impact=medium|effort=S] "Add to your calendar" can silently create duplicate Apple Calendar entries
[friction|impact=medium|effort=S] Calendar export is bulk-per-day only, not per-event
[improvement|impact=medium|effort=S] Grid is the default face; Agenda answers the daily-habit question faster
FLOW: Activities / Explore (events, clubs, trails)
[friction|impact=high|effort=M] Explore events have no RSVP action — the model doesn't even carry RSVP state
[friction|impact=high|effort=M] Explore cards are dead-ends — no detail view, and a full detail screen already exists unused
[longterm|impact=high|effort=L] Foundational bet: a single reusable ActivityDetailView for event/club/trail/place
[friction|impact=medium|effort=S] The time-frame filter — one of the two primary levers — is hidden in a small overflow menu
[improvement|impact=medium|effort=S] Explore has no live-now indicator, even though the app already defines one
[improvement|impact=medium|effort=M] Club cards show a static schedule string, never the real next meeting date
[innovation|impact=medium|effort=M] No data-driven 'this weekend' shelf to spark discovery beyond the flat feed
[improvement|impact=medium|effort=M] Recurring-event grouping collapses a whole series behind one date with no way to see the others
FLOW: Profile / identity + global composer (Add)
[friction|impact=high|effort=S] The "+" composer is invisible on the two screens most tied to posting
[longterm|impact=high|effort=L] Community identity is never actually shown to the community
[friction|impact=medium|effort=S] Trail and Club location fields skip the curated-venue autocomplete Events get
[friction|impact=medium|effort=S] Profile lists your plans and clubs but gives you no way to undo them
[innovation|impact=medium|effort=S] The kind-chooser treats Event, Club, and Trail as equally likely first taps
[innovation|impact=medium|effort=M] Composing an event/club/trail is a bare form with no sense of "this will go live in town"
[improvement|impact=low|effort=M] "Quests completed" is a bare number with nowhere to go
FLOW: Whole-app product thesis, retention & long-term bets
[friction|impact=high|effort=S] The daily quest — the app's one built-in daily loop — has no authoring UI
[friction|impact=high|effort=M] No in-app moderation queue — content growth is capped at one person checking Supabase by hand
[improvement|impact=high|effort=M] Going/joined counts are anonymous numbers in a town where everyone plausibly knows each other
[longterm|impact=high|effort=L] No re-engagement surface exists once the app is backgrounded — a foundational push gap
[longterm|impact=high|effort=L] Real civic recurring content currently depends on one manual research-and-SQL pass, not an ongoing pipeline
[friction|impact=medium|effort=S] Home leads with two competing "read of today" cards
[longterm|impact=medium|effort=S] Guardrail: keep "Today" a flat, complete list — never let growth pressure turn it into a ranked feed
[innovation|impact=medium|effort=M] No low-stakes way to post a one-line neighbor update short of a full Event/Club/Trail form
ARCHITECTURE — full detail
TOPIC: Codebase architecture, concurrency, testability, tech debt
[priority=high|effort=M] Give AuthStore/CommunityAPI a protocol seam so features are unit-testable without the network
[priority=high|effort=S] Stand up a minimal XCTest target and start with DateHelpers + RealtimeClient reducer
[priority=high|effort=S] Add a single, brand-safe error/observability hook instead of the current silent-swallow-everywhere pattern
[priority=medium|effort=M] Unify the five ad-hoc LoadState shapes into one shared type
[priority=medium|effort=S] Break up the two largest Views (ActivitiesView, CalendarView) before they grow further
[priority=low|effort=S] Fold the growing .shared singleton pattern into the same DI pass as AuthStore/CommunityAPI
TOPIC: Backend/data platform, two-repo sync, scale & long-term foundations
[priority=high|effort=S] Bring the Postgres schema under version control
[priority=high|effort=M] Close the client-side status-authorization gap before content volume grows
[priority=high|effort=S] Give the two-repo "backend twin" a real sync mechanism, not a comment
[priority=medium|effort=M] Add a minimal last-good-snapshot cache for the core screens
[priority=medium|effort=M] Model recurring events as a recurrence, not N duplicate rows
[priority=medium|effort=S] Add a server-side kill switch and minimal ops visibility — no analytics SDK
[priority=low|effort=S] Harden Codable decoding against a single bad row blanking an entire screen
